about.body: The AJ200P is Land Rover's 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four petrol engine, part of the Ingenium family introduced a year after the diesel AJ200D. It's fitted across five Land Rover model lines — Defender, Discovery, Discovery Sport, Range Rover Evoque and Range Rover Velar — in outputs ranging from 200 to 300 hp. The AJ200P is the petrol counterpart to the AJ200D, sharing the same basic architecture while using a twin-scroll turbocharger for improved response and different timing and valvetrain components.

byModel.body: In the Defender (L663), the AJ200P powers the P300 variant from 2020 onwards. The Discovery (L462) uses the same P300 designation from 2017. The Discovery Sport (L550) has the widest spread of AJ200P outputs — P200, P250 and P290 (the latter discontinued after 2020). The Range Rover Evoque (L551) carries P200 and P250 variants from 2019, while the Range Rover Velar (L560) uses P250 and P300 outputs from 2017.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ200P spans five different models across multiple generations — with outputs ranging from 200 to 300 hp — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and ECU calibration. Early vs late production variants differ, with improvements made from 2019 onwards. Registration/VIN matching is required before we confirm any rebuild or replacement. A Defender P300's AJ200P isn't a drop-in match for a Discovery Sport P200's unit, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and ECU software all differ.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
